system.description:
Warlocks are evokers who supplement their casting with the use of their own blood and life force. Warlocks are resilient and utilize a high risk, high reward fighting style that combines the fluidity of hexes with the pressure and aggressiveness of a close range fighter. They can fight up close with strikes of magyk blood or afar with the use of hexes.

Level 1 — Body of War

Your Health starts at 8, and you gain 2 Health every time you gain a level.

Evoker in War

Warlocks can utilize their Maximum Health as a resource through Bloodloss. Some abilities have Bloodloss as an activation cost and others have the option to pay in Bloodloss for strengthened effects.

Bloodloss: A payment made of Maximum Health made by the Warlock. If optional Bloodloss can be applied multiple times. You regain any lost maximum health at the end of the engagement and heal for half that amount.

Due to Warlocks unique relationship with their own life force they can momentarily store vestiges of Mana within themselves. It quickly burns away but can empower some abilities.

Manaburn: Warlocks gain 1 Manaburn per 1 Mana expended. All Manaburn is lost at the start of the following Phase.

Scarlet Strike | Trigger Action | X Bloodloss

Trigger: When you make a Focused Attack.
Your Attacks base damage increases by Bloodloss + Manaburn.

Scarlet Warden | Trigger Action | 1 Stamina

Trigger: You would take damage.
Reduce damage taken by an amount equal to [1.5 x Arcana/Soul].
1 Bloodloss: Scarlet Warden reduces an additional 3 damage.

Level 4

Sin Siphon | Trigger Action | 1 Mana

When you land an Excellent Attack, you can flood mana into your strike to trigger a reaction your blood, causing you to deal additional damage equal to [6 + Manaburn]. You also regain 2 Health and regain 2 Maximum Health if you've lost any.

Blood Tithes | Passive

When you activate an ability that costs Mana, you can choose to pay the cost with Maximum Health. Maximum Health has a ratio of 1:1.

Level 8

Sanguine Ichor | Swift Action | 1 Bloodloss

You cause the blood in your body to swirl with power, infused with the power of your own pain. While Sanguine Ichor is active, your [Reflex] Rolls and Attack Rolls both receive a +1 for 1 Round.
1 Bloodloss: Sanguine Ichor grants an additional +1 to [Reflex] rolls and attack rolls.

Crimson Crown | Swift Action | 3 Bloodloss

You manifest a crown above your head that floats, dripping your own blood at a slow pace. This crown lasts for 5 Rounds or until the end of the engagement. While this crown is in place, it absorbs any excess mana you use. For every 1 Mana you expend while the crown is active, it gains one charge in the form of a bloody gemstone.

You can choose to expend gemstones in one of three ways:

  • Before making an attack roll, adding +1 to the roll per gemstone.
  • Dealing additional damage to any source of damage you inflict equal to +3 per gemstone.
  • Before using an ability that require the target to roll against your Potency, raise your Potency by 1 per gemstone to a maximum of +3.

This crown vanishes early if you are put into Last Breaths.

Level 12

Hemorrhaging Lance | Focused Action | 4 Bloodloss

One of the Warlock's most potent attacks, it requires both hands to be empty to be used. Pooling blood between both hands, you spread it out and form the sanguine liquid into a dangerous spiraling lance before firing it forward. This ability requires a connection to your target beyond Sight. Roll Arcane Sense. The result of your roll determines the range of this ability. Select a target within range, even if you do not have LoS. Once your target is selected make an attack roll.

This attack can pierce through 1 Space worth of cover, dealing damage equal to [3x Arcana/Soul + Manaburn] to your target and the obstruction. If a creature is interrupting your LoS against your target, the creature can make an Evasion check against your Potency. On failure it also suffers the damage of Hemorrhaging Lance.

Sacrifice | Swift Action | 6 Maximum Health

Forged in an age of unending battle and desperation Warlocks are often willing to pay any cost for victory. As a Swift Action, Warlocks can sacrifice 6 Maximum Health that can only be restored by visiting a Spring of Life to regain 3 Mana, all Stamina and gain the ability to use a second Focused action this Phase.

Level 15

Bloodied Eclipse

You have perfected your use of Warlock powers. When you recover Maximum Health at the end of an engagement you also heal that amount.

Masochistic Returns

You can restore expended Stamina with Maximum Health. For every Stamina you recover, you expend 2 Maximum Health.
